verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Browserbase ships an agent SDK (Stagehand) and data extraction features, so model backend choice is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents configuring a local or self-hosted LLM, or any choice of LLM provider, for extraction. Community mentions of open-source alternatives concern self-hosting the browser infrastructure, not the LLM, so they do not count.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
